newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares expected higher in selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares expected higher in selective trade.

text.p: 0645 gmt -- Brokers say Istanbul stock exchange index may test 2,000 level.
* The IMKB National-100 closed at 1,951, up 40 points, or 2.09 percent from Wednesday's close.

* Brokers expect selective trade with higher volume, particularly in some state shares. The government announced on Wednesday that it would speed up privatisation efforts to raise $4 billion this year.
